patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — RingCentral documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist.

RingCentral documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist. Choose RingCentral only if your buying job matches “Enterprise-grade UCaaS / cloud phone platform (RingEX) with deep call routing, video, team” rather than Zenzap's shape. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than RingCentral's shape. Workflow advantage: RingCentral leans business-phone, sales-calling; Zenzap leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — RingCentral documents a broader use-case set; Zenzap is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: RingCentral is Enterprise-grade UCaaS / cloud phone platform (RingEX) with deep call routing, video, team messaging and contact-centre options — Core from ; Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 .
- Company-size focus: RingCentral (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Zenzap (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: RingCentral-leaning business-phone, sales-calling, contact-center vs Zenzap-leaning —.
- Researched limits: RingCentral — Published seat floors are medium confidence — RingCentral often gates exact dollars behind quote/selector flows; Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+.

Limitations — RingCentral: Published seat floors are medium confidence — RingCentral often gates exact dollars behind quote/selector flows; Call recording and deeper CRM/CTI require Advanced or above; Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+.

Poor-fit cases: RingCentral is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Published seat floors are medium confidence — RingCentral often gates exact dollars behind quote/selector flows · Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Avoid RingCentral if you actually need Zenzap's motion (Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
